$schema-note: Blog theme registry. `id` matches src/styles/themes/<id>.css and the data-blog-theme value set on <html>. The Chapbook composer reads this list to render its theme picker; preview{bg,ink,accent} are swatch colours only. An unknown/absent defaultTheme falls back to the base 'observatory' look.

themes.name: Observatory
themes.description: The house style: near-black canvas, teal-to-violet accents and a fine grotesque. Calm, technical, and the default.

themes.name: Ledger
themes.description: Ruled off-white paper with a disciplined grotesque and hairline rules. Reads like a well-kept notebook.

themes.name: Air
themes.description: Maximum whitespace, a single soft-blue accent and quiet type. Nothing on the page you didn't ask for.

themes.name: Graphite
themes.description: A monochrome slate room — cool greys, steel highlights, no colour to distract from the writing.

themes.name: Broadsheet
themes.description: A proper newspaper: a towering serif masthead, multi-column index with column rules and a drop-cap lede.

themes.name: Journal
themes.description: Warm cream stock, elegant book serif and italic datelines. An unhurried literary quarterly.

themes.name: Kiosk
themes.description: Newsstand energy: heavy black Fraunces, a hot tabloid red and headlines that shout across the page.

themes.name: Gazette
themes.description: A boxed masthead, navy double-rules and a formal dateline. Old-world civic newsletter, buttoned up.

themes.name: Neon
themes.description: After-dark and electric — inky violet-black, glowing cyan and magenta, and type that hums.

themes.name: Zine
themes.description: Photocopied punk: high-contrast paper, one screaming spot colour, cut-and-paste rules and heavy caps.

themes.name: Scrapbook
themes.description: Warm craft paper, taped-down cards and a friendly rounded hand. Everything looks lovingly stuck in.

themes.name: Arcade
themes.description: Insert coin: midnight-blue cabinet, chunky pixel-era type and hot arcade yellow and pink.

themes.name: Crayon
themes.description: Bright primary colours, big rounded type and sticker-style accents on clean white. Made to feel like fun.

themes.name: Rocket
themes.description: Blast off into a friendly navy sky with star-yellow and sky-blue. Playful, bold and a little bit space.

themes.name: Storybook
themes.description: Soft pastel cream, gentle coral and sage, and rounded storytime type. Cosy as a bedtime read.

themes.name: Comic
themes.description: Comic-book POW: halftone cream, bold ink outlines and red-and-blue panels. Every post a splash page.

themes.name: Gallery
themes.description: A white-cube gallery: pure white walls, near-black labels and an image-led grid. The work leads.

themes.name: Darkroom
themes.description: Near-black walls and silver labels so photographs glow. Minimal chrome, maximum image.

themes.name: Contact Sheet
themes.description: A film contact sheet: charcoal base, framed thumbnails with numbered edges and monospace grease-pencil labels.

themes.name: Polaroid
themes.description: Instant-photo charm: soft grey desk, white photo frames with a caption lip and a casual retro-blue accent.
